Subscription is not unlimited!!. I subscribed to an annual plan based on the App Store’s description, which claimed unlimited access to all app functionalities during the trial period. However, I discovered that I only receive 3 credits every 7 days, rendering the app unusable until the credits reset.

The exact wording from the App Store reads, “By subscribing, you get unlimited access to all the app’s functionality for the entire duration of your subscription period.” This clearly contradicts the reality and constitutes blatant false advertising.

If you intend to limit the access, it should be prominently stated in the app description that you receive 3 credits per week.

I utilized my 3 credits, and the results were satisfactory, but insufficient to rate the app based on its actual merits, excluding the deceptive pricing.

Also, why don’t you allow a prompt input ability to talk to the server and ask for the pose or just give feedback about that pose and get what we want faster. The designs they chose to have are either really weird and creepy (like.. why are we allowing people to upload images of adults, and then make them into infants or children? Ick.) or just not functional. For example - any design that features unique clothing renders the image with strange details that don’t make sense. Sleeves will be attached to nothing. Weird neck collars will appear without an actual shirt, etc. I would say - this is a great idea, but it seems rushed and needed more review before being released. There should have been more manual intervention on the part of the creators to correct a lot of the mistakes that the AI is making in rendering these images. I wish they had waited - it wouldn’t be such a waste of money, then. In my opinion- wait a few months to a year until a better app comes out. Save your money, not worth it.
